title: Among Magyar's supporters, "one word keeps coming up: hope"
summary: "This is a clear battle between two men, the incumbent, Prime Minister Viktor Orban and far right leader, and the opposition leader Peter Magyar, a conservative, pro-European figure," said FRANCE 24 Journalist Clovis Casali, reporting from Budapest, Hungary.
